commands.name: FailSlaReportAttempt
steps: validate failure_code against FailSlaReportAttemptRequestV1 outside the writer lock; never accept a filesystem path, candidate filename or cleanup target from the failure caller

inside one bounded UoW resolve command receipt first: exact committed command_id/command_type/request_hash replay returns the original ReportAttemptV1 before current state/revision checks; any mismatch is IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT
revalidate exact expected revision and require state in staging|ready_to_generate|generating|verifying; completed, failed and cancelled attempts are not mutable failure targets
if state=verifying, capture the persisted bounded unverified candidate filename for post-commit housekeeping only; never derive a cleanup target from request data
insert one command receipt before last_command_id reference
delete only this attempt's non-authoritative staging children in FK-safe order: sla_report_member_tier_results, sla_report_member_snapshots, sla_report_cohort_snapshots, report_section_snapshots

zero all staged counts; clear snapshot_hash, artifact_filename, artifact_sha256, artifact_size_bytes and verified_at_utc; set state=failed, bounded failure_code, completed_at_utc=server-now, increment revision/set last_command_id; append exactly one sla.report.cancelled_or_failed.v1 audit and construct ReportAttemptV1

commit receipt, complete staging cleanup, failed state/revision and audit atomically; after commit, best-effort remove only the captured sibling temporary candidate through the filesystem adapter resolved from the existing validated job destination context
rules: the worker/orchestrator assigns one UUID command_id to this exact failure transition before first invocation and reuses it on every retry
COMMAND_ENVELOPE_V1 binds report_attempt_id, expected revision and failure_code; exact committed replay cannot delete rows, advance revision or audit twice
failure cleanup never deletes completed report evidence, a final published artifact, unrelated files, operational records, classification, policy or contributor authority
a rollback removes the receipt, every staging-child deletion, cleared metadata, failed transition and audit together; a failed attempt can never commit with a partial staged population
temporary-candidate cleanup failure is diagnostic housekeeping only and cannot roll back or alter the committed failed state

commands.name: CancelSlaReportAttempt
steps: outside the writer lock validate CancelSlaReportAttemptRequestV1 and resolve no filesystem path or artifact body; the exact linked durable job identity is re-read inside the authoritative transaction

inside one bounded UoW resolve command receipt first: exact committed command_id/command_type/request_hash replay returns the original cancelled ReportAttemptV1 before current attempt/job state checks; any mismatch is IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT
revalidate exact expected attempt revision and require state in staging|ready_to_generate|generating|verifying; completed is immutable and failed/cancelled are not new cancellation targets
load this attempt's exact sla_report_job_refs row and require its linked durable job is SLA_REPORT_GENERATION_V1 contract version 1
if state=verifying capture only the persisted bounded unverified candidate filename for optional post-commit housekeeping; request data never supplies a cleanup target
insert one command receipt before last_command_id reference and build the parent command_context

invoke LLD-01 DurableJobCoordinator.cancel(uow,job_id,SLA_REPORT_GENERATION_V1,1,command_context) in this same UnitOfWork; if Foundation reports completed while the report attempt is still nonterminal fail closed with SLA_REPORT_CANCEL_UNSAFE, while failed/already-cancelled technical job state may still permit this domain cleanup because it has no remaining worker authority
delete only this attempt's non-authoritative staging children in FK-safe order: sla_report_member_tier_results, sla_report_member_snapshots, sla_report_cohort_snapshots, report_section_snapshots

zero all staged counts; clear snapshot_hash, artifact_filename, artifact_sha256, artifact_size_bytes, verified_at_utc and failure_code; set state=cancelled, completed_at_utc=server-now, increment revision/set last_command_id; append exactly one sla.report.cancelled_or_failed.v1 audit and construct ReportAttemptV1

commit Foundation job cancellation/claim revocation, receipt, full staging cleanup, cancelled state/revision and audit atomically; after commit best-effort remove only the captured sibling temporary candidate through the existing validated destination context
rules: COMMAND_ENVELOPE_V1 binds report_attempt_id and expected attempt revision; exact committed replay is resolved before terminal-state guards and cannot cancel the job, delete staging, advance revision or audit twice

CompleteSlaReport and CancelSlaReportAttempt serialize through authoritative SQLite writes: if completion commits first, cancellation observes completed and changes neither job nor report; if cancellation commits first, the worker claim is revoked and every later report transition/CompleteSlaReport revalidation rejects the cancelled attempt

a worker whose claim was revoked may physically finish already-started CPU/file work, including an atomic rename already in flight, but such bytes are external housekeeping only and can never become CompletedReportEvidence after cancellation
cancellation never deletes a final published artifact, completed evidence, unrelated files, operational records, classification, policy or contributor authority
rollback restores the prior Foundation job state/claim together with every report row/metadata/audit change, so a rejected cancellation cannot strand or silently kill its worker
